about: Rent schedule parity fixtures (PLAN WP23a/WP23b). Identical in command-centre and rpcc-functions; Jest asserts them against FE computeRentSchedule/resolveScheduleRent and BE computeScheduleRows/resolveScheduleAnnual. input.terms (optional) are the lease's cpiCapPercent, cpiFloorPercent and reviewRatchet. rawPercent/appliedPercent are a review's increase before and after cap, floor and ratchet, to 4 dp. 'frontend' blocks cover car parks, misc fees and incentives, which only the frontend computes today. Expected values are derived by hand from the rules, not captured from either engine. Version 3 (PLAN WP26c): input.terms.workflowLiveFrom is REVIEW_WORKFLOW_LIVE_FROM (an unsettled review row dated on or after it is pending, awaiting_review); a step's ratchetExempt { at, byName, reason } is a director's override of the lease's ratchet for that row only; input.reliefs are ratified rent reliefs { id, from, to (inclusive), kind percent | amount | fixed_rent, value, scope } laid over the rows, input.pending are changes awaiting a director { requestId, kind, from, to, summary }, input.ancillaries the car park and misc fee totals a year per row. 'charges' blocks are asserted against BE computeCharges / chargedOn / chargesOver / reliefForgone (src/scheduleCharges.ts) and their frontend mirror: periods (lease and charged figures a year, cut where the row in force or the reliefs change; from null = the stored base rent, to exclusive, null = open), rowPending (each row's pending requestIds), on (the period in force on a day), over (pro rata by day on a 365-day year, each slice to the cent) and forgone (one relief's charge forgone over its own days). Version 4 (WP26c review): a fixed-rent relief charges the lower of its value and the lease rent; input.carparkGroups and input.miscFees, when given, are turned into each row's car park and misc fee figures by each engine's own ancillariesByRow (BE src/rentReview/cascade.ts, FE src/helpers/scheduleAncillaries.ts) in place of input.ancillaries, and each group and fee is charged only on its own days: a car park group from its commencedAt (a group at $0 a month is no charge), a misc fee from its commencedAt to its endsAt inclusive; the timeline is cut at those dates. charges.ancillaries pins those figures per row: carparks and miscFees are the row's totals a year as the schedule screens show them, dated.carparks and dated.miscFees each group's and fee's figure a year with its own dates { annual, from, to (exclusive; null = no end) }, groups and fees in input order.
